original_defect: The original answer and semantic step2 expand Q*T*Q as sum(QP)*rho*(QP), losing the reversed adjoint. For Q=X,rho=I/2 that wrong sum is zero, whereas the conjugated twirl is I/2. Products of distinct Hermitian Paulis are not generally Hermitian.

substantive_reconstruction.correct_noncommutative_expansion: For each Hermitian-unitary Pauli Q, Q(P rho P*)Q*=(QP)rho(QP)*; the right factor is P*Q*=PQ. For fixed Q, P->class(QP) permutes four Pauli classes, and a unit phase omega cancels exactly with its adjoint phase. This proves Q T Q*=T and hence QT=TQ, then commutation with all generated products and central phases.
substantive_reconstruction.schur_trace: On actual C^2 the irreducibility in the question and finite complex Schur yield T=lambda I. Every conjugation has trace tr rho=1 by cyclicity and P*P=I, so tr T=1=2lambda. Thus T=I/2 for every density rho, with no entrywise calculation required.
substantive_reconstruction.full_answer_extensions: Positivity is unnecessary for the linear map identity T(A)=tr(A)I/2, a valid additional consequence of the same proof for arbitrary 2x2 complex A. No formal theorem or implementation resources are inferred. There is no empty/dimension-zero parameter hidden in the fixed C^2 contract, and the fixed four-element sum uses normalization1/4 consistently.
substantive_reconstruction.necessity_and_minimality: Restoring the adjoint in answer/rubric/exposition is necessary and directly fixes the witnessed false equality. The candidate supplies the complete sum/permutation proof without restricting input matrices or introducing hypotheses. No residual mathematical defect found in any candidate formula or quantifier.
